### Taste...Enjoy It!
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/taste-enjoy-it-today-s-insight-january-14-2016.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 4:4-5
Points:
- God gave humanity taste buds to enjoy the sensory experience of food and drink.
- Rushing through meals keeps people from appreciating God's physical blessings.
- As Paul taught Timothy, everything God made is good when received with thanksgiving and prayer.
- Believers are encouraged to slow down and savor their meals as divine gifts.

### Power Point - December 16, 2004
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-december-16-2004-1301501.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 4:1-2
Points:
- God installed the conscience and the Holy Spirit as inner boundaries against wrongdoing.
- Repeatedly transgressing moral boundaries causes the conscience to become seared and numb.
- A corrupted conscience can trigger false guilt or feel no remorse over genuine sin.
- Believers must stay aligned with God's Word to maintain clear discernment and freedom.
